_comment: Owner: SIGNAL (01). JSON not YAML because the package has zero runtime
dependencies and stdlib has no YAML parser -- see docs/yoga/01-wire-contract.md.
EVERY BAND BELOW IS A GUESS. Band the bud to the left forearm, calibrate in
Mountain, run `make monitor`, hold each pose, and write down what you see.
Angles are degrees relative to the calibration zero. Classification uses
pitch and roll only -- yaw drifts and is display-only.
This file is re-read on every calibrate/start/reset, so you can retune
between demo runs without restarting the server.
